title: What have you used Fable for?
author: MichaelEmouse
selftext:
I have 24 hours to burn through half a Claude Pro weekly usage limit on Fable. I'm looking for ideas.

  
What have you used Fable on?

  
What could Fable be best used for when it comes to game development?

comments.author: SlRenderStudio
comments.body: contribute to texture craft app bug fixes , maybe write user guide documentation for it

comments.author: count023
comments.body: debugging, refactoring bad code (dedup, function optimization, dead code) and reverse engineering via ghidra.

comments.author: timbo2m
comments.body: Audit and refactor this codebase, splitting it up into a modular architecture that's easier to maintain and test quickly

comments.author: IndianaNetworkAdmin
comments.body:
I focused on getting vertical slices of specific systems. Placing objects in the world, hiring NPCs to run shops and stands, and logistics on moving things back and forth across the map.

Be careful - Mine burned a bunch of tokens on creating simple 3D models of things that I already had ready to go in my assets.

I stretched mine further by letting it run my zcode CLI, so it has been using GLM 5.3 for the agentic work and it's been handling the architecture.

I burned through all my Fable 5.2 usage by around 4 p.m. today, but I had a single Fable 5.2 usage reset so I'm letting it go some more. I've got 46% left to burn through.

I also knocked out a few persistent bugs, and had it go through and double check my multiplayer foundations to make sure I hadn't neglected to include any systems in multiplayer prep.

I've already been working to make sure everything's a modular addon for Godot, so IMO building new systems and verifying the complex ones I have already was the best way to go.

comments.author: eschaff2114
comments.body: Building an engine that will go behind a game I’m planning along with a piece of software. Astra wasn’t getting anywhere with it and Fable has given me some really good progress.

comments.author: lemonlemons
comments.body: I have a city builder / transport tycoon game where a city can have 1500 cars driving around at any time and they can get stuck etc. Fable was able to get the traffic working much better than Opus.
